content.text: Release readiness: what has to be true before the Q4 launch. Each component owner refreshes the table below every Monday; ask in the launch channel if a row looks stale.
Crash-free sessions above 99.9% for three builds in a row. Remaining work: the share-sheet regression on iPad landscape and the German and Japanese localisation pass.
Rows marked At risk get a daily check-in until they are back on track. The API row is paused until the vendor ships its SDK update.
Readers per day across the pilot cities for the last full week, with the change against the week before. Scroll the table sideways to see every day.
Numbers are synthetic and exist only to exercise the table layout.
Next review: the Monday after the code freeze.
